cause: Even with the network request only at allocation scope, including single_node_vni caused the native multi-node srun to report task-0 Error configuring interconnect. The controller was still a separate one-node srun even though it needed only bounded TCP metadata.
correction: Run the metadata controller directly in the node-0 batch shell, eliminate the one-node Slurm step and single_node_vni entirely, and request only job_vni for the sole exact two-node native CXI step.
